## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry beach cover-up
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals
- Flip-flops
- Lightweight shorts/jeans
- Long-sleeve shirt for cooler evenings
- Hoodie or light jacket
- Lightweight pants for hiking
- Towels

### Toiletries
- Sunscreen (high SPF)
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Water bottle
- Snorkel gear
- Sun hat
- Sunglasses
- Flip-flops
- Travel-sized toiletries
- First-aid kit
- Insect repellent

### Miscellaneous
- Travel documents
- Cash and cards
- Travel insurance
- Travel adapter
- Camera
- Beach umbrella
- Snorkel mask
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear
- Travel-sized toiletries
